description: State eyes AI-led diagnostics, telemedicine and digital public infrastructure to boost healthcare delivery.
body_lead: Lucknow: The Uttar Pradesh government is set to launch the two-day UP AI and Health Innovation Conference in Lucknow on Monday, in the run-up to the India AI Impact Summit scheduled for February. The conference, to be inaugurated by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath , signals the state government’s strategic push to align healthcare delivery with India’s emerging national AI agenda.
